ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.label: harvest push
ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.description: Everyone to the fields: sow, tend and harvest from first light to last. Crops come in faster and fuller; backs ache. Growers love it, the lazy curse it.

effects.li: Plant work is 30% faster and harvests yield 5% more.
Growers like it; the lazy and undergrounders hate it.

plain.li: Every hour in the field now is a meal in winter.

cheerful.li: Dirt under every fingernail! My favorite kind of week!

cold.li: Yield per day up a third. Correct priority.

plain.li: I'll be picking corn in my dreams.

blunt.li: My back. My back is going to sue the council.

gloomy.li: Bent double for days, and the blight will come anyway.

ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.label: building season
ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.description: Every spare hand on walls, floors and tunnels. Construction and mining go much faster, and everyone goes to bed covered in dust.

effects.li: Construction is 30% faster and mining 20% faster.
Builders, miners and the industrious like it; the lazy hate it.

plain.li: Give me a week and you won't recognize the place.

cheerful.li: Walls! Floors! A whole new wing! Hand me a hammer!

cold.li: Concentrated labor finishes projects. Scattered labor starts them.

plain.li: I've had rock dust in my teeth for three days straight.

warm.li: I'll help. I just wish someone would build a bath first.

blunt.li: Build it yourselves. Oh wait, we are. All of us. Constantly.

ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.label: best behavior
ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.description: Everyone on their best behavior: polite to traders, patient with prisoners, charming to visitors. Trading, recruiting and talking people round all go better. The abrasive find it exhausting.

effects.li: Negotiation and social impact up 25%: better recruiting, taming talk and diplomacy.
The kind and the sociable like it; the abrasive hate it.

plain.li: A smile costs nothing. Unlike our last trade.

warm.li: It's nice, everyone being nice. Can we keep it?

cold.li: Courtesy is a negotiating tool. Use it.

blunt.li: If I have to say "please" one more time I'll bite someone. Politely.

plain.li: My face hurts from all the smiling.

gloomy.li: Pretending to like people. Exhausting. Same as usual, but out loud.

ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.label: days of mourning
ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.description: Work stops, mostly, so the colony can grieve together. Those who lost someone heal faster and are less likely to break. Only possible while someone is grieving.

effects.li: Grief fades much faster, and nobody breaks as easily.
The grieving are grateful; psychopaths and the industrious find it a waste.

plain.li: We owe them this much. A few days of quiet.

warm.li: Come sit with me. Tell me something about them.

gloomy.li: We should do this more. We lose people often enough.

cold.li: The dead don't need our labor-hours. The living do.

plain.li: I grieve better with a shovel in my hand.

ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.label: on guard
ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.description: Weapons within reach, eyes on the horizon, sleep in shifts. Everyone fights a little better and tires a little faster. Fighters like the edge; the nervous jump at every shadow.

effects.li: Better aim and melee: shooting accuracy and hit chance go up.
The bloodthirsty like it; the nervous and wimps hate it.

plain.li: Let them come. We'll see them first.

blunt.li: Finally. I've been sleeping with a knife anyway.

plain.li: Every snapped twig sounds like a raid now.

gloomy.li: Waiting for death, but in shifts.

warm.li: Can we at least take turns being scared?

ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.label: clean sweep
ColonyCouncil.DecreeDef.description: Scrub everything: floors, tables, bedding, the hospital twice. Cleaning goes much faster, wounds are tended more carefully, and bodies fight off illness better. Nobody enjoys it except the fastidious.

effects.li: Wounds are tended better and immunity builds faster.
Doctors like it; the lazy hate it.

plain.li: I've been waiting years for someone to order this.
I scrubbed the same floor three times. It's still a floor.

cheerful.li: Bubbles! Lots of bubbles! I'm trying to make this fun!
